description: Defines a templated expiring cache class with expiration policies, eviction handling, and iteration support, used for managing cache entries with expiration times.

classes.name: NoopEvictionHandler
classes.description: Default eviction handler that performs no action on eviction.

classes.name: ExpiringCache
classes.description: Templated cache class that stores entries with expiration policies, supports eviction, iteration, and automatic pruning.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the value associated with a key if it is valid at the given time.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cache entry with expiration time.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries to maintain cache size.

methods.name: Evict
methods.description: Removes a specific entry and calls the eviction handler.
